Anim.description: AT2: how a light moves or blinks (the runtime animates it from the world's time).

mode.description: `blink` on for `amount` of each period (an aviation light); `sweep` its yaw swinging `amount` degrees either way (a searchlight).
mode.title: Mode

phase.description: Its share of a period at time 0 (a building's lights blink together).
phase.title: Phase

Anim.title: Anim

FarCard.description: AT7: a light as the far city shows it past the live set (`far.py`, scope 6.6).

h_m.description: A pool's light over its middle (m), its falloff: the luminance $L_0 (1 + (r/h)^2)^{-3/2}$ to its radius; a wash's half height.
h_m.title: H M

pos.description: A glow's lens, a pool's middle (on its surface, `FAR_POOL_UP_M` over it), a wash's patch middle (m, absolute z).
pos.title: Pos

size_m.description: A glow's size near (m); a pool's radius; a wash's half width.
size_m.title: Size M

tier.description: Where it fades in: past the street's live range (`mid`), the high tier's (`high`), the beacons' (`fixture`).
tier.title: Tier

type.description: `glow` the fixture seen from afar, a dot turned to the eye; `pool` where a light aimed down lands, a disc on the surface under it; `wash` a flood's lit patch on its facade.
type.title: Type

value.description: A glow's intensity toward the eye (cd); a pool's or wash's luminance at its middle (cd/m2); in the plan's frame (its `night_ev100`).
value.title: Value

yaw.description: A wash's facing (degrees counterclockwise from east): a flat card on its facade.
yaw.title: Yaw

FarCard.title: FarCard
